dct_description_sm:
This theme represents the limit of the Quebec territory of the Agreement on Sustainable Water Resources of the Great Lakes and St. Lawrence River Basin. It was generated from the grouping of watersheds at a cartographic scale of 1:20,000. For more information: http://www.environnement.gouv.qc.ca/eau/grandslacs/2005/index.htm

**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
